scripts.image: npm run stage && docker build -t barrier-brain-runner build
scripts.local: npm run image && docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 -v "$PWD/.local-r2:/data" -e LOCAL_R2_DIR=/data barrier-brain-runner
scripts.bucket: wrangler r2 bucket create barrier-brain-runs && wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle add barrier-brain-runs expire-runs runs/ --expire-days 90 --force
scripts.secrets: wrangler secret put RUNNER_TOKEN && wrangler secret put AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID && wrangler secret put AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
scripts.deploy: npm run stage && wrangler deploy --var CODE_VERSION:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
